WITH member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    link_to_major,
    COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
total_members AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM member
)
SELECT
  mc.link_to_major,
  mc.member_count,
  CAST(mc.member_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(tm.total AS FLOAT) as fraction
FROM member_counts mc
CROSS JOIN total_members tm
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in member.link_to_major represent members with no major and should form a single group in the results
The denominator for the fraction calculation includes all members (those with and without a major), not just those with assigned majors
